title: Incorrect default type for _PathT_co
detail: The default type for _PathT_co is set to 'str | bytes | os.PathLike[str]' only when TYPE_CHECKING is True or Python version is 3.13 and above. For other versions, it defaults to 'Any', which can lead to type errors.

title: Incorrect type check for path_type
detail: The type check for path_type does not handle the case where path_type is a subclass of os.PathLike. This can lead to incorrect type conversions.

title: Incorrect type parameterization
detail: The test checks the type parameterization of click.Path at runtime, which can lead to false positives or negatives depending on the Python version.

title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition `if not self.disable:` should be `if self.disable:` to correctly handle the disabled state. The same applies to line 1177.
